Most Valorant pros play between 200–320 eDPI. Find what feels comfortable for you — there is no "perfect" eDPI.

What is eDPI?

eDPI (effective Dots Per Inch) is the true measure of your aiming speed. It's calculated by multiplying your mouse DPI by your in-game sensitivity. Two players with different DPI/sens combos but the same eDPI will have identical cursor movement speed. This makes eDPI the universal metric for comparing sensitivity between players.

Formula

eDPI = Mouse DPI × In-Game Sensitivity
